nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; written by acceptOwnership and the constructor, read by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by changeOwner and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Owned.changeOwner(address payable) public onlyOwner; queues a new owner address.
Owned.acceptOwnership() public; promotes newOwner to owner when the caller matches newOwner.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for ownership checks and balance accounting.
ERC20 token symbol, initialised to Dcash in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, initialised to DeFi Cash in the constructor.
ERC20 decimals, initialised to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, initialised to 18000000e18 in the constructor.
Mapping of holder balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom and seeded in the constructor.
Nested allowances mapping, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256) public; moves tokens from msg.sender to _to with inline overflow/underflow require checks.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public; spends allowance to move tokens between accounts.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256) public; sets the allowance from msg.sender to _spender.
ERC20.balanceOf(address) view public; returns the stored balance of _owner.
ERC20.allowance(address,address) view public; returns the stored allowance pair.
Capped supply constant set once in the constructor; never enforced in mint logic because there is no mint.
DeFiCash constructor(address _owner); sets token metadata, supply, maxSupply and allocates all tokens to the owner.
receive() external payable that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ether transfers.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Write newOwner = _newOwner, executing only after the access-control require.
Write owner = newOwner guarded only by an un-authenticated msg.sender == newOwner comparison.
balances[msg.sender] -= _amount and balances[_to] += _amount arithmetic on unchecked word-size values.
balance and allowance subtractions plus destination credit in transferFrom, guarded by multi-condition require.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount direct allowance overwrite without any gating.
Constructor initialisation writing symbol, name, decimals, totalSupply, maxSupply, owner and the owner balance slot.
Unconditional revert in receive(), causing ether sent to the contract to be rejected (potential griefing/DoS of funding flows).
Address parameter _newOwner of changeOwner; becomes the pending newOwner.
Destination address _to of transfer.
Amount _amount of transfer.
Source address _from of transferFrom.
Destination address _to of transferFrom.
Amount _amount of transferFrom.
Spender address _spender of approve.
Allowance amount _amount of approve.
Owner address _owner of allowance.
Spender address _spender of allowance.
Address parameter _owner of balanceOf.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
Initial owner address _owner passed to the DeFiCash constructor.

edges.reason: changeOwner is gated by the onlyOwner modifier whose body is the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
Execution reaches the newOwner assignment only after the onlyOwner require passes.
acceptOwnership conditionally executes the owner = newOwner write.
transfer executes the balances subtraction and addition statement.
transferFrom executes the balance and allowance arithmetic block.
approve executes the allowance storage overwrite.
DeFiCash constructor performs the token initialisation writes.
receive() unconditionally executes the revert.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require, making caller identity the sole authorisation signal.
The stored owner address is read inside the onlyOwner require.
Authorization of the newOwner write indirectly derives from msg.sender through the modifier.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state write.
The write operation stores _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender to newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership reads the pending newOwner state variable.
The ownership write is authorized only by the attacker-influenceable msg.sender comparison.
newOwner is copied into owner by the acceptOwnership write.
The write operation mutates the owner state variable.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping that is debited in transfer.
Stored balances are read to compute the debited and credited amounts.
The _to parameter indexes the credited balance slot.
The _amount parameter is the value added and subtracted to balances.
The arithmetic result is written back to the balances mapping.
The _from parameter indexes the debited balance and allowance slots.
The _to parameter indexes the credited balance slot.
The _amount parameter is subtracted and added during the transferFrom arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance entry consumed by transferFrom.
Stored balances are read and updated inside transferFrom.
The stored allowance is read and decremented inside transferFrom.
Updated balances are written back to storage by transferFrom.
The reduced allowance is written back to storage by transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key set by approve.
The _spender parameter is the allowance key set by approve.
The _amount parameter is the allowance value set by approve.
approve writes the allowance value into the allowed mapping.
balanceOf looks up the balances mapping using its _owner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping from storage.
balanceOf returns the stored balance through the named return variable.
The _owner parameter is the outer allowance key in allowance().
The _spender parameter is the inner allowance key in allowance().
allowance() reads the allowed mapping from storage.
The constructor _owner parameter becomes the privileged owner address.
The constructor initialisation assigns the owner state variable.
The constructor initialisation writes totalSupply.
The constructor initialisation writes maxSupply.
The constructor mints the entire supply into the owner balance slot.
The constructor sets the token symbol.
The constructor sets the token name.
The constructor sets the token decimals.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only feeds the newOwner assignment and has no independent behaviour.
The destination argument is only an index into the balance update operation.
The amount argument is consumed entirely by the transfer arithmetic.
The source argument is only an index into the transferFrom arithmetic.
The destination argument is only an index into the transferFrom arithmetic.
The amount argument is consumed entirely by the transferFrom arithmetic.
The spender argument is only the key of the allowance write.
The amount argument is only the value of the allowance write.
The owner argument is only a read key of the view allowance function.
The spender argument is only a read key of the view allowance function.
The owner argument is only a read key of the view balance function.
The named return variable carries no logic beyond returning the balance lookup.
The constructor argument is consumed by the initialisation writes, notably the owner assignment.
